releases.notes:
## Additions

- Added alert exclusion zones. Create as many as you need to suppress alerts for Pokemon in a certain radius (e.g. at a spawn, lobby, or pasture area). These work per server/world so you can define them separately if you play on multiple servers. (Thanks to Dunaka on discord for the suggestion)

## Additions

- Added owner username to Jade tooltip options for pokemon entities.
- Added a form tag to the alert filter builder (e.g. `form=alolan`).
- Increased the max value of the extreme large threshold from 1.9 to 4.9.

## Fixes

- Fixed move inspector tooltips rendering behind other ui elements.

- Reformatted Kotlin files using kltint.
